cc:Work.dc:description: Audience-written assertions, not an independent oracle · one earlier native attempt per target The new 1,348 RDPro full-source targets (629 Scala + 719 Java) are excluded from these completed-bank results. RDPro here is the earlier 16-target pilot. Source: preserved current-native records, 17 November 2026.
